decisions.reason: Changing the issue month from December to November does not alter the article-ending layout rules. The separate image-placement instruction in the same message is already represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY.
The issue-month correction does not change the required author name, photograph, source, matching rule, or placement.
Identifying the issue as the November issue does not change its polished, modern, Civic Lantern-aligned visual style.
The issue-month correction does not change the requirement to improve publication image quality when necessary.
Changing the issue month does not alter the Civic Lantern website as the required source of article content.
The November issue label does not alter the requirement for creation of the magazine layout template.
The issue-month correction does not change the requirement that advertisements render clearly without blurriness.
The word 'label' overlap is incidental; changing the issue month does not alter article categories, category mappings, label style, or placement.
The issue-month correction does not change which cover-mentioned articles must be included or how their placement is determined.
The issue-month correction does not resolve or alter the free-platform and white-label branding requirements.
Identifying the publication as the November issue does not change its supplied content inputs, assembly behavior, or Flat Plan reference.
The issue-month correction does not change the required tribute-page content or its placement toward the end of the magazine.
